column3: “The reign of Darius” replaces Darius the king; through renders by the hand of.
“Consider carefully” renders set your heart upon.
“Harvested” specifies brought in; never have your fill renders not to drunkenness, and the wage earner is addressed directly.
“Consider carefully” renders set your heart upon.
“Down” is supplied with bringing wood; lumber specifies wood.
“Blew away” renders blew upon; being busy with a house interprets running to it.
“On account of you” interprets over you.
“Fields” specifies the land; your is supplied with hands.
“Because” interprets just as; fearing the LORD condenses fear before His face.
“Delivered the message” renders speaking in the LORD’s message.
